people.name: Abdeel
people.line: Father of Shelemiah, an official under King Jehoiakim

people.name: Azriel
people.line: Official sent to arrest the prophet Jeremiah

people.name: Baruch
people.line: Jeremiah's scribe who recorded and delivered his prophecies.

people.name: Hammelech
people.line: Father of Jerahmeel and Malchijah (or 'Malchiah'), officials during Jeremiah's time.

people.name: Jerahmeel
people.line: Son of Hammelech, sent to arrest Jeremiah.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Seraiah
people.line: Son of Azriel, sent to capture Jeremiah and Baruch

people.name: Shelemiah
people.line: Sent with Jerahmeel to arrest Jeremiah

translations.web: The king commanded Jerahmeel the king’s son, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet; but Yahweh hid them.
translations.bsb: Instead, the king commanded Jerahmeel, a son of the king, as well as Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel, to seize Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet. But the LORD had hidden them.
